## About

I am a Postdoctoral Researcher at the **Scuola Superiore Meridionale (SSM)** in Naples, Italy.

My research lies at the intersection of **stochastic control, optimization, applied probability, and decision-making under uncertainty**, with particular interests in stochastic control, distributionally robust optimization, and Markov jump systems.

[Research](research.qmd) · [Publications](publications.qmd) · [CV](cv.qmd)

Stochastic Control · Distributionally Robust Optimization · Markov Jump Systems · Applied Probability
